import subprocess, pathlib, os

    r=subprocess.run(['bash','-lc','make -j2 test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer '+path],cwd=p,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    print(name,r.returncode,r.stdout.decode(errors='ignore')[:500])
